# Pro-MBS

> Pro-MBS is a comprehensive medical billing, coding, and revenue cycle management solutions provider delivering 99% claim success rates and specialized healthcare services for U.S. practices.

Pro-MBS (Pro Medical Billing Solutions) offers end-to-end medical billing outsourcing, coding specialties, revenue cycle management, and healthcare IT support. Based in Webster, TX, the company serves diverse healthcare settings including physician practices, ambulatory surgical centers, and home healthcare agencies.
